text: I think that if it's required to pay to use the app, it should be explicitly written in the description. But obviously it's not the case. It seems like everyone nowadays want to exploit people with mental health problems.
author: Dragana DC

text: The to-do section has no way to allow me to complete my tasks which leaves this section useless at this stage. Otherwise I have enjoyed this app but I'm not sure how long I'd use without the to do section working...

text: it's not user-friendly! in fact I feel your a scam I want my money back!!!! can't use app at all.

text: An app for ADHD people that isn't showing you ANYTHING AT ALL before it needs your payment data. They say you can have 3 free days before they take your money, but we all know their business model is based on the fact that you will forget about the app and you will forget to cancel the payment even if the app is not for you, as it's just another ToDo list with pomodoro timer. Abhorrent practice to target the vulnerable in this way.

text: Even the subscription doesn't work. Very slow

text: I assume thus is for children because it is SO patronising. Contains no tools or systems to help you, just "brain trainers" with "tips" you learned when you were 10 like "use a highlighter when studying". Useless.
author: Sophie *

text: Might be great, but I couldn't try it out without agreeing to a subscription with only a 3 day trial. (Which is very short for someone with ADHD.) Not worth the "ADHD tax" risk, So I'm deleting it. Let me know if you decide to do a 10 day trial so we can actually experience it.
author: Shane Butler

text: Love this app. Really made for my neurodivergent brain
author: Candice Brassard

text: I really, really wanted to try focus genie out, but 3 days is not long enough for someone with ADHD to properly try out ANYTHING. I just know that it will take me at last a few days to even remember that this is something that I have access to in order to start building up the habit, and by then the auto subscription fees will already have been taken. Please consider extending the trial to at least 2 weeks, so that we have the chance to actually give this a proper go before spending our money.
author: Liana Mostafa

text: At first it was working pretty good. Helpful but could use reminders to use it. I logged out because customer service suggested to and haven't been able to login because I forgot my password. Also, clicked on forgot password multiple different times and nothing sent. So I've been trying to get some help but nothing has been solved. So I'm losing three weeks of a paid app 😠 Very slow customer service.
author: Jennifer Anderson

text: glows: earning tokens and badges for finishing tasks; the bitesize lessons are very engaging and informative; a lot of visuals and easy-to-use tracking; the brown noise is great for focusing Grows: i wish there was a little more on the app to keep it interesting. I think a med tracker would be great to monitor med effectiveness, especially for users with a menstrual cycle. A brain dump space would also be useful. Overall, a good 1st version; obviously designed by adhd brains for adhd brains.
author: Jessyca Goodwin

text: Incredible work!
author: Mahbubur Rahman

text: So many good things in this app. I tend to forget to feed and water myself and not remember but now I have an app that I can track these things. I love the work break timer and use it every single day for homeschooling my kids which actually gives me a few min break that I otherwise forget. I also love being able to make a digital list I can check off... it's super satisfying
author: Cassie Campbell

text: I'm very much enjoying this app! You learn alot, also great for anyone! Can't wait to see and learn more 😊
author: Whitley Biggs

text: Bah. I wanna learn more but it's stuck behind a paywall. No free trial? But when you offer a free trial I'll certainly try this one. Update: OK I see you've now added a free trial. Happy to try it out
author: Ross
developer_reply: Hi Ross! FocusGenie does offer a 3 day free trial, where you can use all our features without being charged. If you decide not to continue, feel free to cancel anytime within the 3 day time period. We do hope you will give us a try!

text: Wish a helpful app didn't cost anything. Not that it's a lot it's just unfortunate nobody can get help that could use this app
author: D Boz
developer_reply: Hi D Boz! We hear you. There is a 3 day free trial, so you can see if you like it! If you choose to continue, we've aimed to price our app as economically as possible without impacting user's experience with distracting ads.

text: I'm not sure if this was actually developed with people who have ADHD in mind or if they just white labeled someone's app with some customization. But given that you can't even set tasks to reoccurring tells me in the very least that no QA/QC was done by people who actually have ADHD. I also want to add that the 3 day free trial almost seems predatory given the target audience. Un-installed almost immediately
author: Matthew Davis
developer_reply: Hi Matthew. Thanks for your feedback. FocusGenie was created by a Board Certified Psychiatrist, specializing in ADHD and who has it herself. We are actively looking into implementing the reoccurring task option in our upcoming builds. Regarding the trial, we wanted to offer a free trial so people could explore the app without commitment.

text: Could be a great app, but one critical feature does not work- being able to show that you completed a task. Really sad until that feature gets fixed. Thank you.
author: C M
developer_reply: Hi MC - We’re so sorry you faced this issue. Our development team has resolved this issue. If you log out and log back in you should be able to access that feature without problem! If you run into any further issues please reach out to our team via support@thefocusgenie.com. We so appreciate your patience and feedback during our launch.

text: Looks way too overwhelming. No free features? No thanks
author: Vanessa Piper
developer_reply: Hi Vanessa! There is a 3 day free trial, so you can see if you like it! We understand a new app can be overwhelming, so we created a fun and easy swipe-through demo that takes you through all of the features and how to use them.

text: I love the idea of this but it didn't go through enough user testing (also don't charge beta testers). You can't mark a task complete and you can't add task category. This is a main feature of the app (tasks) and it doesn't work. Also the trial period is too short and you need a bug reporting mechanism (separate from feedback or public ratings). Finally I can't seem to cancel. The app sends me to Google play but Google play isn't giving me this option. Please cancel my subscription. Tysm
author: Adrienne Janney
developer_reply: Hi Adrienne - Thank you for loving this idea and having patience with us during our launch. We’re so sorry you faced these issues. Our development team has now resolved these bugs. If you run into any further issues please reach out to our team via support@thefocusgenie.com and we would be happy to assist you!

text: I love the ideas behind this app, but I'm having similar experiences as others that I cannot check off any of my to do list items and I get error messages when I try to complete Brain Trainers (unless I go through them twice) or fill out my daily Focus Tracker. Really hoping I didn't waste $50 on an app that I can't use cuz I would LOVE to utilize this.
author: Kathleen Ewanowski
developer_reply: Hi Kathleen! We’re so sorry you faced these issues. Good news...our dev team has now resolved them. If you log out and log back in you should be able to access that feature without problem! If you run into any further issues please reach out to our team via support@thefocusgenie.com. Please keep us posted on how you are enjoying the app!

text: I really really wanted to like this app. But the to-do list doesn't have reoccurring tasks. So if you need to remember something every day you have to enter them individually. Have to manually set mic & notification permissions. The prompts for the journal are unfinished or odd, ex. "How did heartbreak change your outlook?" No ability to individualize task categories. Unsubscribed for now. Hopeful for future updates. Feedback sent to devs.
author: AK Faery
developer_reply: Hi AK! Thank you so much for your feedback. We are actively looking into implementing a reoccurring tasks feature as well as adjusting the task categories. Our journal questions are open ended prompts and track how you respond to year over year. If anything else comes to mind, please reach out to us at support@thefocusgenie.com :)

text: Awesome app
author: Aman Singh
developer_reply: Hi Aman! We're so glad you are loving our app :) Stay tuned for the monthly educational modules drops -- they're so fun!

text: I'm loving the concept and the colors. Since everything is short and bite sized, it keeps me entertained and I wanna check out all the different brain trainers. However, when I go through the brain trainers for the first time, when swiping to the last card, it closes and shows "Error completing Module" and then if I open the same one again and swipe through then it completes the module. Also I can't complete tasks on my to-do list. When I click on the button to cross it off, nothing happens.
author: Rosalie Shrestha
developer_reply: Hi Rosalie! We're so glad you are loving the concept and design :) Regarding the issues you have faced, our development team has now resolved them. If you run into any further issues please reach out to our team via support@thefocusgenie.com. We so appreciate your patience and feedback during our launch.

text: It should be crystal clear on download and before you create an account that this is a 100% paid app.
author: Rich Vedas

text: Disappointing 😞 Can't check out the any of the features without paying. There is nothing to tempt me to want to pay. Yea you can have a 3 day trial but expecting someone with ADHD to remember to cancel that subscription after 3 days is unrealistic. I would consider if there was a 2 -4 week free trial. But 3 days is just not worth it.
author: Beth Laustsen

text: Love the tracking and to do lists. Great way to feel organized even when I'm feeling scattered!
author: Kelsey Bouchard
developer_reply: Hi Kelsey! Thank you so much for your review. We're so glad you are loving the app :) Lots more good stuff to come!

text: An app for ADHD that has a monthly payment option? No thanks. We all know that we'll forget to cancel and not even be using this app.
